title: VGG 3x3 convolution golf

paper.title: Very Deep Convolutional Networks for Large-Scale Image Recognition
paper.year_note: Original/preprint year except GCN (2017 venue, 2016 preprint) and speculative decoding (2023 venue, 2022 preprint).

statement: Implement VGG 3x3 convolution golf: stack 3x3 convolution blocks and minimize parameters at fixed CIFAR-10 quality. Read the linked paper and isolate the named mechanism. Write a self-contained solve(data), fit using training tensors only, and return Submission(model=model). Keep validation labels out of fitting and preprocessing. This is an educational reduced-scale adaptation, not a claim to reproduce original paper results. Use cifar10; required output: [N,3,32,32] -> [N,10] logits. Evaluate accuracy (maximize). Parameter golf at a declared quality target using 3x3 stacks. Required ablation: Replace two 3x3 convolutions with one 5x5 layer at matched output width. Curriculum draft: reference, task-specific objective/evaluation adaptation and thresholds remain unimplemented; a named dataset may have a loader but this does not make this model executable. The provided solution raises NotImplementedError.
